theorems.name: Submission.second_fundamental_form_chart_formula
theorems.statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
